title: VitaCore
tagline: The largest & deepest global health dataset: decentralized model for true longevity & better healing
description:
VitaCore is a comprehensive health data platform that unifies DNA data, medical records, and real-time wearable metrics into the world's largest global health dataset. To bypass complex international healthcare regulations, VitaCore leverages a decentralized architecture to enforce absolute data sovereignty. Because health data is inherently personal property, individual data sharing cannot be restricted by traditional legal silos. It belongs entirely to the user.

To drive immediate market adoption, VitaCore's initial launch targets international patients and longevity enthusiasts. These high-potential early adopters actively seek out and fund medical experiments; VitaCore enables them to fuel these trials with massive, standardized streams of real-world data. Designed for enterprise scalability, VitaCore features robust data pipelines built for seamless integration by industry giants. Ultimately, VitaCore bridges commercial viability and profound social impact, democratizing advanced medical insights while lowering the cost of healthcare devices and treatments globally.
how_its_made:
Proof of Personhood: Every critical user action triggers a verification step through World Selfie Check. This process guarantees that the interacting entity is a unique, living human being without exposing sensitive biometric data.

Cross-Chain Identity Anchoring: To prevent data fragmentation and identity spoofing, the platform uses the unique hash of the World verification process. This hash is deterministically linked to the user's Ethereum (ETH) address, ensuring that all subsequent data points are cryptographically proven to originate from the exact same entity.

Decentralized Data Sovereignty: All generated data points are securely captured and anchored on the Sui network. Leveraging Sui's object-centric data model, users retain 100% ownership and granular control over how their data is shared, monetized, or utilized by third-party applications.
auto_summary: A health data platform prototype that links World verification, Ethereum identity anchoring, and Sui-based storage for user-controlled records.
